responsibility: Implements core C++ tree-node utility logic and language-dependent tree helpers. It classifies lvalues/xvalues, provides cp-specific operand-length and expression-location helpers, frees or rewrites C++ front-end metadata before LTO/output, supports warning predicates like zero-as-null-pointer-constant, and contains assorted low-level tree manipulation and validation routines that underpin the cp tree representation across the front end.
